summary: New pinned set android-fs-compat in the existing openclaw-compat owner: nothing on 2026.9.6; on 2026.10.9, 12 public modules (OpenClaw dist and @openclaw/fs-safe 0.26.0) get EACCES copy fallbacks, rename-based migration artifact moves and an unavailable pid namespace. Applied/checked by runtime-sync, gateway-start, undone by the deploy rollback.
reason: S24 31/10: /proc/self/ns/pid is absent (ENOENT) and hard links and clones are refused (EACCES) in the Termux sandbox. OpenClaw 2026.10 fails to start its gateway lock and its session migration without these fallbacks (openclaw-android Script v1.2.5 and v1.3.0). The upstream content-based patch applies fully to the 2026.10.9 candidate installed on the S24 (patched=18, problems=0); its result is pinned here byte for byte.
